verdict.rationale: Deel's official MCP server is documented as exposing payroll data to Claude, ChatGPT, or custom agents, with tools that map to API operations. An agent could therefore read payroll information and flag issues itself. However, the evidence never shows a payroll-preview endpoint or tool, any anomaly detection, or an approve-run step the agent could gate. Missing for 10: documented payroll preview/dry-run API or MCP tool, built-in anomaly or variance surfacing, payroll run approval endpoint, independent or hands-on corroboration.
